name: Isabel-Ulrike Hager
forbes_bio: Isabel-Ulrike Hager is a major shareholder of Hager SE.
The company is a leading provider of solutions and services for electrical installations, covering business fields such as energy distribution, cable management, and building automation.
Hager SE generates consolidated group revenues exceeding $3.5 billion annually.
Originally founded as a GmbH, the company has a history spanning over three decades and transitioned into a Societas Europaea (SE) in May 2007.
The group operates internationally with a workforce exceeding 13,000 employees and manages well-known brands such as Hager, Berker, and E3/DC.

name: Chris Britt
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2021-2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2025)
forbes_bio: Chris Britt cofounded San Francisco startup Chime in 2013 as a mobile banking app and debit card with no monthly fees.
In September 2020, Chime raised $485 million in funding at a $14.5 billion valuation, nearly tripling its value in six months.
During the pandemic, one of Chime's most popular features was a stimulus advance--it let users borrow $1,200 before the government checks arrived.
It took Chime five years to reach one million customer accounts. One year later, in 2019, it had four million.
Prior to starting Chime, Britt worked at Visa and prepaid card company Green Dot.

name: Fernando Masaveu Herrero
forbes_bio: Fernando Masaveu Herrero is the fifth-generation leader of Corporacion Masaveu, a Spanish conglomerate that has been family-run since its founding in 1840.
He currently serves as chairman of Corporacion Masaveu, and is the president of the family's philanthropic foundation.
Based in Asturias, Corporacion Masaveu's diverse holdings span from industrial cement factories and renewable energy to real estate, finance, health, wineries, and carparks.
Masaveu Herrero additionally owns significant individual stakes in Spanish companies such as Bankinter, Linea Directa, and Logista, as well as investments in Portugal and the U.S.
forbes_facts: The Masaveu family's private art collection includes over 1500 works and is considered one of the most significant in Spain.

name: Sergio Fogel
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2024); Hurun Global (2024)
forbes_bio: Sergio Fogel is the cofounder of Uruguay-based fintech dLocal; he owns about 17% of the shares and left the company in early 2026.
Founded in Montevideo in 2016, dLocal went public on the NASDAQ in June 2021, just nine months after becoming Uruguay's first unicorn in September 2020.
dLocal operates in emerging markets such as Brazil and India and its clients include Amazon, Netflix, Google, Microsoft, Nike and Spotify.
Fogel started dLocal with board member Andrés Bzurovski and the firm's founding CEO, Sebastián Kanovich.
The three are all alumni of Uruguay's Universidad ORT and previously worked together at payments firm AstroPay, also founded by Bzurovski and Fogel.

name: Charles Dunstone
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2012-2022); Hurun Global (2014-2020); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: In 1989, Charles Dunstone started Carphone Warehouse in his apartment with $12,000 in savings.
In 2000 the company floated on the London Stock Exchange as U.K. mobile phone sales boomed.
In 2014, Carphone merged with Dixons, a general electronics retailer. In 2021 Dixons Carphone was then folded into the 800-store Currys brand.
Dunstone also founded TalkTalk network in 2002, which demerged from Carphone Warehouse in 2010 but remained listed.
In 2020 TalkTalk was taken private by Toscafund and private equity firm Penta.
forbes_facts: Outside of the office, he is an avid yachtsman and participates in sailing regattas around the globe.

name: Kim Jae-young
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2023-2024); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Kim Jae-young is the founder, chairman and CEO of online game developer Lionheart Studio.
He set up the firm in 2018 with investments from South Korea's Kakao Games and Wemade, a pioneer of blockchain-based games.
Lionheart has created Odin, one of the country's most popular mobile games.
Kim also cofounded online game company Action Square in 2012, which went public in 2015.

name: Yang Tingdong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023-2024); Forbes annual (2001-2024); Hurun Global (2018-2022); Hurun China (2010-2021)
forbes_bio: Yang Tingdong's fortune comes from his stake in rice-wine supplier Jiangsu Yanghe Brewery.
Yang chaired the company from 2002 to 2012.
Yanghe boasts subsidiary brands Yanghe and Shuanggou with more than 1,300 years of history,

name: Li Guangyu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2018-2021); Hurun Global (2018-2021); Hurun China (2017-2021); Hurun Self-Made Women (2020)
forbes_bio: Li Guangyu chairs China Yuhua Education, whose private schools educate nearly 50,000 students in China.
Zhengzhou-headquartered Yuhua provides education from kindergarten to college at 16 campuses.
Li set up his first school in 2001 after operating a trading company.
Li graduated from the Changchun Institute of Optics and Fine Mechanics, majoring in laser technology, in 1983.
He holds an MBA from the Guanghua School of Management at Peking University.
